evidence: Added "Notes" text field via Configure Fields; it appeared as new column in table and as a field in cards, and as a labeled input in Add Entry form.
Created entry "Test Entry QA" with text, number(5), date(2026-09-01), checkbox(true), notes text; all values shown correctly in table and card views.
Switched Table<->Cards multiple times; entry count (6) and field values remained identical across switches.

Sorted Cards by Priority asc then desc; sorted Table by Due Date asc. Switching views preserved each view's own sort (Cards stayed "Sorted by Priority (descending)" while Table was "Sorted by Due Date (ascending)").
After sorting by Priority and Due Date, entry count remained 6 and all field values were unchanged, only order changed.
All 6 entries and field values (including empty Notes shown as "—") displayed consistently in both table and card views.
Configure Fields dialog shows type dropdown labeled Text/Number/Date/Checkbox; Add Entry form renders text input, number spinbutton, date picker, and Yes/No checkbox accordingly.
Table view: check icon (green, text-success) for true vs X icon (muted) for false. Card view: "Yes"/"No" text with matching icons.
Selecting Priority field immediately reordered entries; sort button label changed to field name and footer showed "Sorted by Priority (ascending/descending)"; app remained interactive afterward.

With sort cleared, used keyboard drag (Space/ArrowDown/Space) on drag handles to reorder entries in both Table and Card views. Each view retained its own distinct manual order when switching between them (Table: Review,Update,Design,Prepare,Team,Test; Cards: Review,Update,Prepare,Team,Design,Test).

actual: No filter control exists anywhere in the UI. Searched the toolbar (Sort, Table/Cards, Add Entry, Search), Configure Fields dialog, column headers, and card field labels for a filter affordance; none exists. A DOM-wide search for the word "filter" found zero matches. Only quick text search is available, which is a different feature (IX-17).

issue: Filtering feature is missing, so criteria matching cannot be verified
actual: No filter UI or control exists in the application (verified via DOM inspection - no "filter" related elements found), so entries cannot be filtered by field criteria and the clear/restore behavior cannot be tested.

evidence: Searching lowercase "design" matched "Design new landing page" (case-insensitive), updated count to "1 entry matching "design"". Clearing search (X button) restored all 6 entries.

issue: Search matches only raw internal values, not the formatted values shown to users
actual: Searching "Jan 15" (the displayed date format) returned 0 results, but searching the raw ISO value "2026-01-15" returned the matching entry. Searching "Yes" (the displayed checkbox state) returned 0 results despite 3 entries showing "Yes" for Completed.

evidence: Priority field renders as native input[type=number] (spinbutton); attempting to type "abc" was rejected by the browser ("Cannot type text into input[type=number]"), preventing non-numeric values from being entered/saved.

Due Date field renders as native input[type=date]; attempting to set invalid date "2026-02-30" (Feb 30 does not exist) was rejected ("Malformed value"), preventing an invalid date from being saved. Valid date 2026-09-01 was accepted and saved correctly earlier (Test Entry QA).

actual: No import control/button exists anywhere in the UI (toolbar or Configure Fields dialog). The Configure Fields dialog only contains a note text mentioning "Configure fields before importing data" but there is no actual import mechanism to upload or paste data. A DOM-wide search for "import" found only this note text, no functional import UI.

issue: New entries do not persist across page reload
actual: Created entry "Test Entry QA" (with values for Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, and a custom "Notes" field) which appeared immediately in both views. After reloading the page (http://localhost:6074/), the entry count reverted to the original 5 entries, "Test Entry QA" was gone, and the custom "Notes" field/column disappeared entirely — none of the data was persisted.
